mapper.select:
SELECT FROM EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION E WHERE E.ACTIVITY = '1' AND E.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND UPPER(E.COURSE_NAME_CODE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{courseName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) || '%'
AND E.IMPLE_START_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND E.IMPLE_END_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{endDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
ORDER BY E.CREATE_DATE DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION ( BASIC_NO, PLAN_NO, TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, COURSE_NAME_CODE, TRAIN_FORM_CODE, TRAIN_ADDRESS, IMPLE_START_DATE, IMPLE_END_DATE, IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR, IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT, TRAIN_CONTENT, COM_TEACHER_EMPID, COM_TEACHER_NAME, EVA_TEACHER_EMPID, EVA_TEACHER_NAME, PLAN_EMPLOYEE_EMPID, DES_DEPARTMENT, PLAN_EMPLOYEE_NAME, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, CPNY_ID, PERIOD_TIME, APPLY_END_DATE ) VALUES ( #{basicNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{planNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{trainTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{courseNameCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trainFormCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trainAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{impleStartDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_DATE(#{impleEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), #{impleClassHour, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{impleClassUnit, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{trainContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{comTeacherEmpid, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{comTeacherName, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{evaTeacherEmpid, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{evaTeacherName, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{planEmployeeEmpid, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{desDepartment, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{planEmployeeName, jdbcType=CLOB}, SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{periodTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{applyEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY') )
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION SET IMPLE_START_DATE = TO_DATE(#{impleStartDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), IMPLE_END_DATE = TO_DATE(#{impleEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), IMPLE_CLASS_HOUR = #{impleClassHour, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IMPLE_CLASS_UNIT = #{impleClassUnit, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TRAIN_CONTENT = #{trainContent, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EVA_TEACHER_EMPID = #{evaTeacherEmpid, jdbcType=CLOB}, EVA_TEACHER_NAME = #{evaTeacherName, jdbcType=CLOB}, DES_DEPARTMENT = #{desDepartment, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, APPLY_END_DATE = TO_DATE(#{applyEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_IP = #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE BASIC_NO = #{basicNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(P.PLAN_NO) AS PLAN_NO, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(P.TRAIN_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS TRAIN_TYPE_CODE_NAME, P.COURSE_NUMBER, P.COURSE_NAME_CODE, P.PERIOD_TIME FROM EDU_PLAN_MANAGER P WHERE P.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND P.ACTIVITY = 1 ORDER BY P.COURSE_NAME_CODE, P.PERIOD_TIME
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_PLAN_MANAGER P SET P.ACTIVITY = 1 WHERE P.PLAN_NO = (SELECT B.PLAN_NO FROM EDU_BASIC_INFORMATION B WHERE B.BASIC_NO = #{basicNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}) AND P.ACTIVITY = 2
mapper.select: SELECT E.FREE_NO, E.BASIC_NO, E.EMPID, E.LOCAL_NAME, E.FLAG, (SELECT GET_DEPT_NAME(H.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H WHERE H.EMPID = E.EMPID AND H.CPNY_ID = E.CPNY_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS DEPT_NAME, (SELECT GET_GLOBAL_NAME(H.POST_GRADE_NO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) FROM HR_EMPLOYEE H WHERE H.EMPID = E.EMPID AND H.CPNY_ID = E.CPNY_ID AND ROWNUM = 1) AS POST_GRADE_NAME, E.EVA_RESULT FROM EDU_FREE_EMPLOYEE E WHERE E.BASIC_NO = #{basicNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND E.ACTIVITY = '1' AND E.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY E.FLAG, E.EMPID
